objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with generalized fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, over the past 2 months I’ve had steadily worsening generalized fatigue and severe itching all over my body, with yellowing of my eyes and many scratch marks on my trunk and arms. I have ulcerative colitis and hypertension, and I’m on lisinopril and rectal mesalamine.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you wake up gasping for air during sleep? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any episodes of stopping breathing or waking up gasping for air during sleep.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain in one spot, swelling or bruising that’s getting worse, deformity, or trouble using the area normally? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any injury or symptoms like severe pain in one spot, swelling or bruising, deformity, or trouble using a specific area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared with the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed redness or warmth on my left wrist compared with the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, from a bump or injury), or any new discoloration there?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any chest wall bruising from an injury or any new discoloration there.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed urinating much more than usual or producing a larger amount of urine.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances such as alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs in the past or currently?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t use tobacco, cannabis, opioids, or stimulants, and I rarely drink alcohol.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had trouble controlling my urine—I’m not leaking and I’m able to make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion (such as a new spot, sore, mole, or patch) anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin lesions like new spots, sores, moles, or patches—just the severe generalized itching and the scratch marks on my trunk and arms.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only lasted a short time)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently—none at all.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—just widespread severe itching and lots of scratch marks on my trunk and arms.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or ankles?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in my legs, including around my calves or ankles.”
